label: has legal address
definition: indicates the legal address for the entity, in the jurisdiction in which the entity is established, used for registration purposes with respect to obtaining an LEI

label: has legal form
definition: indicates the nature of the entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective in a given jurisdiction

label: is consolidated by
definition: indicates the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) from an ISO 17442 perspective

label: is consolidation of
definition: indicates the entity considered the 'start node' or consolidated entity from an ISO 17442 perspective

label: is directly consolidated by
definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) fully consolidates the accounting of the 'start node' (child) per the accounting rules specified, and is the closest consolidating entity to that child in any applicable ownership hierarchy

label: is an international branch of
definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'start node' or consolidated entity (child) is an international subsidiary of the 'end node' (parent) in the jurisdiction of the child

label: is ultimately consolidated by
definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) fully consolidates the accounting of the 'start node' (child) per the accounting rules specified, and is the most distant consolidating entity to that child in any applicable ownership hierarchy

label: has legal form abbreviation
definition: the precise abbreviation for the entity legal form as defined in the jurisdiction in which it is registered, for example LLC, LLP, Ltd, PLC, Corp.

label: has ownership percentage
definition: the percentage ownership interest in the owned entity owned by owning entity, if known

label: has transliterated legal form abbreviation
definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of the abbreviation for the entity legal form

label: has transliterated name
definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of a name for the entity

label: is quantified by
definition: indicates that something is limited to or conditional due to some rate or other statistical value

label: has buying currency
definition: indicates the currency purchased with respect to a currency or related instrument

label: has calculation agent
definition: indicates a party (role) responsible for determining the value of an instrument

label: has commodity value as of execution date
definition: indicates the per unit value of a given commodity as of the date that the contract is executed

label: has nominal value
definition: indicates the face value of a contract

label: has principal executive office address
definition: relates an organization, specifically the issuer of a financial instrument, to its principal executive address, as required for issuance of that instrument

label: has redemption terms
definition: indicates the specific terms related to redemption as specified in the instrument or a related contract document

label: has selling currency
definition: indicates the currency sold with respect to a currency or related instrument

label: has shareholder
definition: indicates a party that holds shares in the issuer

label: has underlier
definition: relates a derivative to something on which the contract is based

label: has value expressed in
definition: relates something, such as an instrument or index, to the currency its value is typically expressed in

label: holds shares in
definition: specifies the issuer in which a shareholder holds an equity position

label: is denominated in
definition: indicates the currency in which the financial instrument was issued

label: is legally recorded in
definition: jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city) in which the financial instrument is legally recorded for regulatory and/or tax purposes

label: is negotiable
definition: specifies whether a particular financial instrument is or is not transferable

label: has closing price determination method
definition: indicates a strategy by which the official closing price is determined

label: has price determination method
definition: indicates a strategy by which a given price is determined

label: has pricing source
definition: indicates the origin of a given quote or price for a financial instrument

label: has rate of return
definition: indicates the retrospective rate of return for a given financial instrument over some period of time

label: has trading date time
definition: indicates the specific date and time associated with a given price

label: has book depth
definition: indicates depth of the order book to which the price refers

label: has lot size
definition: magnitude of an item (i.e., total quantity)

label: has number of days accrued
definition: indicates the number of days for which interest has accrued and has not yet been received

label: has quote lot size
definition: magnitude of something to which the quote price refers

label: has round lot size
definition: standard number of securities traded on an exchange

label: has trading volume
definition: indicates the number of shares/units traded on a given trading day

label: exposes in
definition: indicates the state of affairs in which exposure occurs

label: facilitates
definition: acts as an enabler in a situation in which an event, a task, a conversation or something else occurs

label: has exposed party
definition: indicates the party subject to influence or risk in

label: has exposure to
definition: involves influence or risk from

label: has generating entity
definition: specifies a legal entity that generates something

label: has generating entity identifier
definition: specifies an identifier for the entity that generated a unique transaction identifier

label: has registered agent
definition: identifies a party as one that has the legal, medical or financial capacity to act on behalf of someone else under specific circumstances

label: has offering
definition: relates something to a voluntary but conditional promise submitted by a buyer or seller (offeror) to another (offeree) for acceptance, and which becomes legally enforceable if accepted by the offeree

label: has offering amount
definition: indicates the notional monetary amount, determined based on reference data, market rates or some other agreed method associated with some offering

label: has offering price
definition: indicates the price associated with an offering, which may be an explicit or calculated price

label: has selecting party
definition: indicates the person(s) or organization(s) responsible for determining the contents of a basket

label: has settlement date
definition: indicates the date by which an executed order or transaction must be settled

label: has trade date
definition: indicates the date on which a security or other instrument-specific trade actually takes place

label: is embodied in
definition: identifies the representation or tangible form of something in some context

label: is exposed party in
definition: indicates the state of affairs in which the party bears the risk

label: is exposed to
definition: is subject to influence or risk from

label: is exposure of
definition: is the influence or risk borne by

label: is facilitated by
definition: identifies someone or something that expedites some event, transaction, conversation or something else in some context

label: is offering of
definition: relates an offering to one or things that are the subject of the offer

label: relates to
definition: has a logical or causal connection with

label: has nominal number of units
definition: indicates the base number of units of something associated with some offering

label: has offering units
definition: indicates the actual number of units of something, including any premium on the number of units, associated with some offering

label: has selection criteria
definition: describes the methodology or program used to determine the membership of a collection

label: has acquisition price
definition: has a value as of the date of acquisition, expressed as an amount of money, other financial assets, or goods

label: has owned asset
definition: indicates the asset in an ownership situation

label: has owning party
definition: identifies the actor that holds title to the asset in an ownership situation

label: is asset of
definition: identifies the owner of an asset

label: is owned asset
definition: indicates the context of ownership in which something is an asset

label: is owned by
definition: indicates something that someone owns

label: is owning party
definition: indicates the context of ownership in which the party plays the role of owner

label: owns
definition: indicates something that a party holds title to and may possess

label: owns asset
definition: identifies an asset that an owner owns
